fragrance oils, certified organic essential oils, and other soap supplies.  In addition to a
complete line of specialty ingredients, we have also expanded our offering with a complete line of
ready to private label products including bath bombs, cold process soaps, candles, and personal care
products.  Lastly, we have leveraged our economies of scale to introduce wholesale products and
fragrances from some of the world's best-known brands.

# Soap Making Supplies from The Nation's Largest Online Supplier of Fragrance Oil, Soap Bases,
# Essential Oils & Specialty Ingredients

Since our inception in 2010, Bulk Apothecary has quickly expanded to become the nation’s leading
supplier of soap making supplies and specialty ingredients. Our meteoric rise is directly related to
our strong focus on superior quality and excellent customer service. This commitment has allowed
us to build relationships with millions of customers that trust us as their source for premium
fragrance oils, certified organic essential oils, and other soap supplies.  In addition to a
complete line of specialty ingredients, we have also expanded our offering with a complete line of
ready to private label products including bath bombs, cold process soaps, candles, and personal care
products.  Lastly, we have leveraged our economies of scale to introduce wholesale products and
fragrances from some of the world's best-known brands.

From Pathway 1 · your first week

### Calm Evening Roller

10 ml roller bottle · 2% dilution · ready in five minutes
* Lavender *(Lavandula angustifolia)* 2 drops
* Sweet Orange *(Citrus sinensis)* 2 drops
* Jojoba carrier fill to 10 ml

**Make it:** add the drops, fill with jojoba, cap and roll between your palms. **Use it:** wrists
and back of the neck, twenty minutes before winding down. Patch-test first. You'll learn why in
Lesson 2.

Every oil we teach with is GC/MS-tested. You'll learn to read the report
Plant-based medicine, shown not told

## This is what "scientifically backed" looks like.

Every recipe in the program comes with the why: the chemistry in plain language, in Karen's margin
notes. Touch an ingredient on the card to see its note. This is Pathway 1's teaching style from the
first lesson.

"Lavender does the calming, and it's the linalool doing the work."

The science: Lavandula angustifolia is rich in linalool and linalyl acetate, the constituents most
studied for relaxation. You'll meet both in the chemistry unit.

"Sweet orange keeps it bright, and it's one citrus that plays nice with skin in the sun."

The science: expressed sweet orange is regarded as non-phototoxic, which is exactly the kind of
safety distinction this course trains you to make between look-alike oils.

2%

"4 drops in 10 ml = 2%. The math becomes second nature, I promise."

The science: dilution is the heart of safe practice, strong enough to work, mild enough for daily
use. Lesson 2 makes the percentages automatic.

Hover or tap the ingredients. Karen annotates every recipe in the coursework this way.

Mastering the Art & Science of Essential Oils

available on its own** in the [course catalog][12], so you can start with a single course and build
from there anytime. Most people begin at Pathway 1, Pathway 2, or Pathway 3, wherever your
experience puts you today. Pathway 4 is where the path leads. The credentials are the proof; the way
you'll care for yours

## Attar Wholesale: From Kannauj to the World — Real Attars, Real Wholesale.

At **Attar Wholesale**, we bring you the finest collection of traditional and modern attars, crafted
using time-honored distillation techniques and 100% natural ingredients. Based in the perfume
capital of India, our mission is to make premium, alcohol-free fragrance oils accessible to
retailers, resellers, and fragrance lovers across the globe. From exotic oud to soulful floral
blends, we offer bulk and private label solutions tailored to your brand’s needs—because authentic
scent should be both luxurious and affordable.

We take pride in being the premier destination for high-quality attars in the United States, India,
Middle East countries including UAE, Saudi Arabia etc, Australia, New Zealand, and in many African
Countries. With our extensive collection of exquisite fragrances, we bring you the essence of luxury
and enchantment. Discover the captivating world of attars and indulge in a sensory experience like
no other.

At Attar Wholesale, we take pride in offering a wide range of attars that are meticulously crafted
to perfection. Our collection includes popular products such as ["Mitti Attar (The Scent of
Rain)][116], [Rose Attar][117], [Ruh Khus Attar wholesale][118], Shamama Attar, Jasmine Attar, Oud
Attar and more.

What sets attars apart from other fragrances is their rich history and traditional production
methods. Derived from natural ingredients, attars are created through a process of steam
distillation or cold pressing, ensuring the preservation of the purest essences. This meticulous
craftsmanship results in fragrances that are not only long-lasting but also deeply evocative.

Each [Kannauj attar][119] in our collection is carefully curated to offer a distinct olfactory
experience. Whether you prefer floral, woody, or oriental scents, we have the perfect attar to suit
your preferences. Our fragrances are designed to evoke emotions, create memories, and leave a
lasting impression.

When you shop at Attar Wholesale, you can trust that you are getting the highest quality
products.Our attars are manufactured by artisans who have mastered the art of fragrance creation
using traditional distillation technique. Our commitment to excellence ensures that every bottle of
attar you purchase is a testament to the finest craftsmanship.

Experience the allure of attars and elevate your fragrance game with Attar Wholesale. Our online
store provides a seamless shopping experience, allowing you to explore our collection and find your
signature scent from the comfort of your own home. With our secure payment options and reliable
shipping, you can trust that your attars will be delivered to your doorstep in pristine condition.

Indulge in the world of luxury fragrances with Attar Wholesale. Immerse yourself in the captivating
scents that have enchanted generations and discover the essence of true elegance. Shop now and
experience the magic of attars.

using time-honored distillation techniques and 100% natural ingredients. Based in the perfume

blends, we offer bulk and private label solutions tailored to your brand’s needs—because authentic
scent should be both luxurious and affordable.

Middle East countries including UAE, Saudi Arabia etc, Australia, New Zealand, and in many African
Countries. With our extensive collection of exquisite fragrances, we bring you the essence of luxury

signature scent from the comfort of your own home. With our secure payment options and reliable
shipping, you can trust that your attars will be delivered to your doorstep in pristine condition.

Indulge in the world of luxury fragrances with Attar Wholesale. Immerse yourself in the captivating

### FAQ: : Aromatic Chemicals in Fragrance Creation

[ What are Aromatic Chemicals? ][178]

Aroma Chemicals are odorous chemical compounds with varying degrees of strength, stability,
tenacity. They are primary building blocks of a Fragrance and are the result of advancements in
synthetic chemistry.

[ What are Natural Aroma Chemicals? ][179]

Natural Aroma Chemicals can be called as Isolates, where in a specific molecular compound is
enriched from a natural source. Most common examples include, Geraniol ex Palmarosa Essential Oil,
Rhodinal ex Geranium etc

[ What are Synthetic Aroma Chemicals? ][180]

These are Synthetic Chemicals that manufactured in a laboratory via Chemical or Biological
processes. For example, Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol, Amyl Acetate etc.

[ Who manufactures Aroma Chemicals? ][181]

There are many manufacturers globally  such as IFF, Symrise, BASF, Solvay, DSM etc and there are
many in each region.

### FAQ: Essential Oils, Pure vs Reconstituted Essential Oils & Aromatherapy

[ What are Essential Oils? ][182]

Essential Oils are volatile oils obtained from plant materials by different methods (distillation,
solvent extraction, cold press etc)

[ What are Pure Essential Oils ][183]
* Pure Essential Oil indicates that an oil is in its purest form without any additional
  solvents/enhancing aromatic chemicals etc.
* Distillation, Solvent Extraction, Cold Press, Enfleurage are some of the methods used in the
  extraction of Natural Oils.
[ What are Reconstituted Essential Oils (RCOs) ][184]

Reconstituted Oils are recreations with synthetic aroma chemicals (found in nature). In most cases
they have a significant portion of the the natural oils too. 

[ Essential oils in Aromatherapy? ][185]
* The health effects of pure natural oils have been established via published research and through
  historical citations. The word 'Aromatherapy' means Healing through Aroma. It involves trained
  certified therapists using the right selection of pure oils for treating various health
  conditions.
* Please note that, there has been widespread misuse in labelling several products that are just
  aromachemicals or reconstituted oils as 'Aromatherapy' products.

### FAQ: : Aromatic Chemicals in Fragrance Creation

[ What are Aromatic Chemicals? ][178]

Aroma Chemicals are odorous chemical compounds with varying degrees of strength, stability,
tenacity. They are primary building blocks of a Fragrance and are the result of advancements in
synthetic chemistry.

[ What are Natural Aroma Chemicals? ][179]

Natural Aroma Chemicals can be called as Isolates, where in a specific molecular compound is
enriched from a natural source. Most common examples include, Geraniol ex Palmarosa Essential Oil,
Rhodinal ex Geranium etc

[ What are Synthetic Aroma Chemicals? ][180]

These are Synthetic Chemicals that manufactured in a laboratory via Chemical or Biological
processes. For example, Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol, Amyl Acetate etc.

[ Who manufactures Aroma Chemicals? ][181]

There are many manufacturers globally  such as IFF, Symrise, BASF, Solvay, DSM etc and there are
many in each region.

### FAQ: Essential Oils, Pure vs Reconstituted Essential Oils & Aromatherapy

[ What are Essential Oils? ][182]

Essential Oils are volatile oils obtained from plant materials by different methods (distillation,
solvent extraction, cold press etc)

[ What are Pure Essential Oils ][183]
* Pure Essential Oil indicates that an oil is in its purest form without any additional
  solvents/enhancing aromatic chemicals etc.
* Distillation, Solvent Extraction, Cold Press, Enfleurage are some of the methods used in the
  extraction of Natural Oils.
[ What are Reconstituted Essential Oils (RCOs) ][184]

Reconstituted Oils are recreations with synthetic aroma chemicals (found in nature). In most cases
they have a significant portion of the the natural oils too. 

[ Essential oils in Aromatherapy? ][185]
* The health effects of pure natural oils have been established via published research and through
  historical citations. The word 'Aromatherapy' means Healing through Aroma. It involves trained
  certified therapists using the right selection of pure oils for treating various health
  conditions.
* Please note that, there has been widespread misuse in labelling several products that are just
  aromachemicals or reconstituted oils as 'Aromatherapy' products.

We are facilitated with an ultramodern manufacturing unit with installed capacity of 10,000 units.
Spread over a huge area of 500 square feet, it is well equipped with all the needed amenities and
machinery. Some of the vital machines installed in the manufacturing unit are extraction unit and
mixer blender. We are backed by extremely professional and talented workforce, who give their 100%
to complete any given bulk order. Further, our strict quality policy and quality experts make sure
that all our manufactured products are free from different kind of of dilution and adulteration. Our
company is growing at a rapid rate under the guidance of our owner **Mr. Gaurav Gupta.** Owing to
his vast industry experience, we have attained a special and leading position in the market.

## Aromatic Chemicals

Being the active manufacturer and supplier of wonderful range of **Aromatic Chemicals**. These are
prepared under moderate temperature which is processed by using the advanced grade of equipment
under the supervision of our experts. Offered product has been gone through various strict quality
checks which ensures their quality. In different industries, these Aromatic Chemicals find their
application for the preparation of number of personal care products, like body lotions, perfumes,
air fresheners, hair oils, bath soaps and many more. These aromatic products have sensual exotic
fragrance which lift the mood and essence. These can be availed in standard packaging which help
them to retain their fragrance and freshness for the longer period of time.

### Essential Oil

From Clove Leaf, Eucalyptus, Lemongrass, Orange to Palmarosa Oil all kinds of **Essential Oil** are
offered by us. It gets extracted from pure and natural compounds and processed by using the modern
techniques. Offered oil has number of health benefits which is known for its aromatic fragrance and
non irritant nature. Available Essential Oil is used for number of purposes, such as oiling, medical
benefits and many more. It is offered in moisture proof packaging which retains the freshness,
fragrance and effective nature. Its zero side effects nature makes it user friendly which can be
availed at highly economical rates.  

[Organic Essential Oil Range ][176]

### Natural Henna

With the assistance of our skilled professionals, we are engaged in providing high quality Natural
Henna at market leading rates. This henna is processed by making the use of 100 percent natural
henna leaves, reetha, shikakai and other basic ingredients in tune with the set industry standards.
It provides natural color to the hair and prevents dual hair formulation and improves the hair
texture. Also, it is widely used to adorn the hands and feet of a bride. This Natural Henna offered
by us is tested by our team of experts to ensure its effectiveness.

texture. Also, it is widely used to adorn the hands and feet of a bride. This Natural Henna offered
by us is tested by our team of experts to ensure its effectiveness.

multiple industries — including personal care, pharmaceuticals, food, and chemicals — for its
ability to attract and retain moisture. Trusted refined glycerine suppliers ensure consistent purity

widely used ingredient in the chemical industry, known for its ability to retain moisture and
maintain hydration in various formulations. Produced from both plant and animal sources, glycerine
is a clear, odorless, and non-toxic liquid that holds a significant place in the beauty,
pharmaceutical, and cosmetic sectors. Glycerine Manufacturers focus on producing high-quality, pure

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for

## Welcome to Ganpati Agri Business Pvt. Ltd.


**Ganpati Agri Business Private Limited** came into being in the year 2011, and under the dynamic
leadership of **Mr. Atul Kumar Singh (MD)** who possesses sound experience in the Rice Bran & other
Agro base industry including mint, flavor, and fragrance industry, we picked up the tremendous pace.
Our modernistic plant is situated at Barabanki, Dewa Road, Uttar Pradesh, which is known as a mint
growing area internationally

The company was incorporated with two directors **Mr. Atul Kumar Singh ,Nikhil** and **Mrs. Anjali
Singh**. Both the directors were already associated with the trading of raw materials like Rice Bran
extract and [Mustard cake][40] and other products which are used in the extraction industry. They
are engaged in agribusiness for the last 25 years.

The area where the industry has been established is industrially developed area land measuring 50000
sq Meters and has all the facilities and infrastructure available at a site like transport, rail
rake facility point & 24 x 7 power supply, etc. The industry is located within 35 Km of Choudhary
Charan Singh International  Airport Lucknow Uttar Pradesh.

## Healing Fragrances Aromatherapy School

Founded in 2002 by Danielle Sade, our mission is to provide the latest education on aromatherapy and
essential oils. Our students will gain a deep understanding of essential oils and an unbiased
education that eliminates misinformation. Our courses can be taken at your own pace, from anywhere
in the world. You will have unlimited access to the learning platform and one-on-one support. 

Upon graduating, you will have the knowledge to succeed at each stage of your aromatherapy journey.
Our graduates have used their knowledge and skills as a solitary vocation in clinical care, skincare
cosmetics, formulators, or have effectively integrated aromatherapy into their careers. Once you
have graduated you will become a Certified Aromatherapy Health Professional (CAHP), recognized by
the Canadian Federation of Aromatherapist. Whether you are looking to invest in your interests or
enhance your career, our courses are designed to take your knowledge to the next level.

## Healing Fragrances Aromatherapy School

Founded in 2002 by Danielle Sade, our mission is to provide the latest education on aromatherapy and
essential oils. Our students will gain a deep understanding of essential oils and an unbiased
education that eliminates misinformation. Our courses can be taken at your own pace, from anywhere
in the world. You will have unlimited access to the learning platform and one-on-one support. 

Upon graduating, you will have the knowledge to succeed at each stage of your aromatherapy journey.
Our graduates have used their knowledge and skills as a solitary vocation in clinical care, skincare
cosmetics, formulators, or have effectively integrated aromatherapy into their careers. Once you
have graduated you will become a Certified Aromatherapy Health Professional (CAHP), recognized by
the Canadian Federation of Aromatherapist. Whether you are looking to invest in your interests or
enhance your career, our courses are designed to take your knowledge to the next level.

# Company Profile

**Offering world, **the finest floral concentrates and natural absolutes

Katyani Exports is a well established group engaged in manufacturing Natural Essential Oils, Spice
Oils, Carrier Oils, Mint Oils and Floral Absolutes on a large scale. The company has two
manufacturing units one is near orcha district in Madhya Pradesh for distillation of Essential Oils
like Cypriol, Ajowain Oil, Cumin Oil, Dill Seed Oil, Carrot Seed Oil, Juniper Berry Oil, Sugandh
Mantri Oil, Valerian Root Oil, etc. and other unit is in Mandsaur (Madhya Pradesh) for manufacturing
of Herbal Extracts and Oleoresins.

3 Decades of Industry Experience

With years of hands-on experience in chemical manufacturing and refining, we have mastered the
technical processes that ensure accuracy, purity, and performance in every product. Our knowledge
and consistency have earned us long-standing trust in both domestic and global markets.

[Commitment to Customer Trust]
Commitment to Customer Trust

We believe in building reliable partnerships. Over the years, our focus has remained on delivering
dependable support, quality products, and timely supply helping our clients scale production with
complete confidence in what they source from us.

[Quality-Driv en Production Standards]
Quality-Driv en Production Standards

Our facility is equipped with advanced testing and analytical capabilities to ensure every batch
meets defined specifications and purity parameters. From raw material evaluation to final dispatch,
we follow strict standards that reflect our dedication to excellence.

[Serving Global Markets]
Serving Global Markets

We have expanded steadily and today supplies premium-grade products to international markets. Our
export capabilities, compliance support, and industry experience make us a dependable global
sourcing partner.

[Extensive Range of Aroma & Essential Ingredients]
Extensive Range of Aroma & Essential Ingredients

Our wide portfolio includes Aroma Chemicals, Essential Oils, Menthol Solutions, and Specialty
Ingredients for fragrance, flavor, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and FMCG industries. Our evolving
product range reflects the needs of modern applications and market demand.

Welcome to Silverline Chemicals

# Lemon Oil Manufacturers In India

**Silverline Chemicals** is recognized as top **Lemon Oil manufacturers** in India. We are also
leading exporter of essential oils, spice oils, aromatic chemicals, herbal extracts and
pharmaceutical raw materials. We deliver high-purity, natural and industry-compliant Lime Oil to
clients across cosmetics, food, pharma, fragrance and aromatherapy sectors.

Pure Essential Oils for Every Application

We manufacture pure and natural essential oils like Lemon Oil, Lime Oil, Lavender Oil, Tea Tree Oil,
[Lemongrass Oil][335], Eucalyptus Oil, Rosemary Oil, Peppermint Oil, Jojoba Oil, Juniper Berry Oil,
Bergamot Oil, Cajeput Oil, Orange Oil, and many more. Our oils meet strict USP/BP/EP standards
providing consistent quality for domestic and international buyers.

[Lemon Oil Manufacturers In India]

Spice Oils, Oleoresins & Herbal Ingredients

We supplies best spice oils and oleoresins - Ajwain Oil, Fennel Seed Oil, Dill Seed Oil, Cinnamon
Leaf Oil, Black Pepper Oil, Cardamom Oil, [Turmeric Oil][336], Ginger Oil and Nutmeg Oil. Apart from
these, we also deals in Coriander, Cumin, Capsicum, Paprika and other oleoresins. We also offer a
wide range of herbal extracts, including Ashwagandha, Shatavari, Amla, Bacopa Monnieri, Tribulus
Terrestris, Garcinia Cambogia and more.

The method of solvent extraction uses a separation solvent, which is generally non-volatile has a
high boiling point and is miscible with the mixture, but doesn’t form an isotropic mixture as a

Supercritical fluid extraction is an efficient separation method of active ingredients from plant
material. Supercritical solvent extraction is one of the gentlest, flexible, dynamic and
nature-friendly techniques used for the extraction of spices, herbs and flowers using food grade
CO2.

points.

super-saturation stage. The crystallisation process consists of two major events – Nucleation &

## Visit Us In Bantry

We have a shop, cafe and bakery in Bantry, a beautiful little village on the bay in West Cork, where
we're surrounded by talented, passionate local producers who bring us an inspiring selection and
variety of products. Visit us to relax over a meal in our cafe, take home a fresh loaf of bread from
our bakery, and stock up on every household and kitchen essential in our shop. Our community is the
heartbeat of Organico so we host lots of events each month, covering a range of topics and
interests, to bring our community together. We look forward to welcoming you.

[[Organico Cafe]][124]

[[Organico Bakery]][125]

**News Organico Blog** [ View All » ][126]
[ Making Hummus at Home  ][127]
[[Rachel holding two pots of homemade hummus, including beetroot hummus, with handwritten labels and
arrows.]][128] Before we were born, our mum, Caroline Dare, spent time making vegetarian food for a
café in Brighton. As a result, we grew up eating homemade hummus, made the traditional way with
chickpeas cooked from scratch, and her recipe is one we've never stopped making. Here in the
Organico Kitchen, we still prepare our hummus from dried chickpeas, and it's one of our favourite
staples for easy summer lunches, picnics and sharing platters. [Continue reading →][129]
[ A Simple Guide to Naturally Glowing Mature Skin ][130]
[[Hannah holding Trilogy Rosapene Bakuchiol Oil and Weleda Skin Food with handwritten product labels
for mature skin skincare.]][131] As our skin matures, it reflects all the chapters of our lives -
the smiles, the outdoor adventures, and everything in between. Caring for your skin as you get older
isn't about trying to look twenty again; it’s about giving it the right support and nourishment so
you feel vibrant, healthy, and comfortable in your own skin. [Continue reading →][132]
[ Why I'm Supporting the Save Our Supplements Campaign ][133]
[[Bottle of vitamins labelled "EU Says No" beside text urging support to prevent the EU reducing
supplement effectiveness in Ireland.]][134] For more than 20 years, I've had the privilege of
working at Organico. Every day I talk with people who are looking for simple, practical ways to
support their health. Some come in looking for Vitamin D to help them through the winter months,
others are searching for magnesium to improve their sleep, Vitamin C and Zinc to support their
immune system, or a good multivitamin to fill nutritional gaps in a busy lifestyle. [Continue
reading →][135]

## Visit Us In Bantry

We have a shop, cafe and bakery in Bantry, a beautiful little village on the bay in West Cork, where
we're surrounded by talented, passionate local producers who bring us an inspiring selection and
variety of products. Visit us to relax over a meal in our cafe, take home a fresh loaf of bread from
our bakery, and stock up on every household and kitchen essential in our shop. Our community is the
heartbeat of Organico so we host lots of events each month, covering a range of topics and
interests, to bring our community together. We look forward to welcoming you.

[[Organico Cafe]][124]

[[Organico Bakery]][125]

**News Organico Blog** [ View All » ][126]
[ Making Hummus at Home  ][127]
[[Rachel holding two pots of homemade hummus, including beetroot hummus, with handwritten labels and
arrows.]][128] Before we were born, our mum, Caroline Dare, spent time making vegetarian food for a
café in Brighton. As a result, we grew up eating homemade hummus, made the traditional way with
chickpeas cooked from scratch, and her recipe is one we've never stopped making. Here in the
Organico Kitchen, we still prepare our hummus from dried chickpeas, and it's one of our favourite
staples for easy summer lunches, picnics and sharing platters. [Continue reading →][129]
[ A Simple Guide to Naturally Glowing Mature Skin ][130]
[[Hannah holding Trilogy Rosapene Bakuchiol Oil and Weleda Skin Food with handwritten product labels
for mature skin skincare.]][131] As our skin matures, it reflects all the chapters of our lives -
the smiles, the outdoor adventures, and everything in between. Caring for your skin as you get older
isn't about trying to look twenty again; it’s about giving it the right support and nourishment so
you feel vibrant, healthy, and comfortable in your own skin. [Continue reading →][132]
[ Why I'm Supporting the Save Our Supplements Campaign ][133]
[[Bottle of vitamins labelled "EU Says No" beside text urging support to prevent the EU reducing
supplement effectiveness in Ireland.]][134] For more than 20 years, I've had the privilege of
working at Organico. Every day I talk with people who are looking for simple, practical ways to
support their health. Some come in looking for Vitamin D to help them through the winter months,
others are searching for magnesium to improve their sleep, Vitamin C and Zinc to support their
immune system, or a good multivitamin to fill nutritional gaps in a busy lifestyle. [Continue
reading →][135]

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?

  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which

  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.

  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only  offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients,
  dyes or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and
  Low Minimum Order Quantity requirement.
* ### Co-Packing & Contract Manufacturing
  
  Contract manufacturing, Co-packing and private labeling is available. Please ask us about this

raw material compatibility research and human clinical efficacy data support.**

  structure, stability, effect and safety. Although both inhibit tyrosinase activity and block
  melanin production, thereby reducing pigment deposition and achieving whitening and freckle
  removal effects, alpha arbutin is resistant to high temperatures (no decomposition at 100°C), acid

  10-15 times that of the β type. It can be effective at low concentrations (about 1/9 of the β
  type). At the same time, it is still non-cytotoxic at high concentrations and is suitable for

  A Alpha arbutin (α-arbutin) and beta arbutin (β-arbutin) are two common cosmetic whitening
  ingredients. Although they belong to the arbutin family, they have significant differences in
  structure, stability, effect and safety. Although both inhibit tyrosinase activity and block
  melanin production, thereby reducing pigment deposition and achieving whitening and freckle
  removal effects, alpha arbutin is resistant to high temperatures (no decomposition at 100°C), acid
  and alkali (stable at pH 5.2-8.0), and has good light stability. It inhibits tyrosinase activity
  10-15 times that of the β type. It can be effective at low concentrations (about 1/9 of the β
  type). At the same time, it is still non-cytotoxic at high concentrations and is suitable for
  long-term use.

[Team Meeting]

Ensuring Your Safety with Every Product

 

At our core, we are dedicated to making sure that the products you use every day are not only
effective but also safe. Our team of expert Safety Assessors works tirelessly behind the scenes to
evaluate, monitor, and guarantee that every consumer product meets the highest safety standards.


How safety assessor can help

By leveraging their expertise, safety assessors help cosmetic companies develop safe, effective, and
compliant products, thus protecting consumer health and ensuring regulatory adherence.


Expertise and Qualifications

Specialized Knowledge: Safety assessors have specialised knowledge in toxicology, dermatology,
pharmacology, or a related field, enabling them to understand the complexities of chemical safety
and human health.

Regulatory Understanding: They are well-versed in relevant regulations and guidelines, such as the
EU’s Cosmetic Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009, FDA regulations, and other international standards.

 

Comprehensive Safety Evaluation

Ingredient Assessment: Assess each ingredient’s safety profile, including potential toxicity,
irritation, sensitization, and other health effects.

Exposure Calculation: Calculate the systemic exposure dosage (SED) for each ingredient based on
product use patterns, ensuring the levels are safe for intended use.

 

Risk Assessment

Hazard Identification: Identify potential hazards associated with the ingredients and the final
product.

Risk Characterization: Evaluate the risk by considering the toxicological data and the exposure
assessment, ensuring that the product poses no significant risk to consumers.

ABOUT US
"Based on details, innovative development" is our eternal goal and principle!

Ji'An ZhongXiang Natural Plants Co.,Ltd.

Ji’An ZhongXiang Natural Plants Co.,Ltd is a factory that specialized in essential oils,carrier
oils， herbal oils, compound essential oils, massage oils, flowers water and some plants extract
like natural borneol,menthol . We not only provide our products in drums,but also offer OEM Service.

As an essential oil manufacturer,we have our own planting base and extraction machine for producing
our products. We also import many raw materials like Rose Flower, Moroccan agran, Australian Tea
Tree leaves,Bulgarian lavender .

In order to offer clients OEM service,we have dust free cosmetic room and machine to offer clients
small bottles essential oils or flowers water. We can customize clients' package or offer
personalized formula.

Quality is always the most effective competitiveness on market, and we always insist in this
principle to offer products to our clients. As a reliable supplier, we have got the certificates of
ISO9001, GMPC. Our laboratory can offer clients the product test results too.

Since company was found in 2010, there are about 200 employees and we have a integral system for
company operation. The system include different departments for management, production, warehouse,
R&D, sales, purchasing, quality, customer service. With continuous development of the company and
the increasing number of employees, our company also purchased a lot of large high-end production
equipments, so sales team moved to a new office building at the end of 2019 and completed the
construction of a new workshop in 2020.

are increasingly scrutinizing ingredient lists and demanding transparency, the allure of Cherry
Blossoms Hydrosol lies in its radical purity. Unlike conventional toners or mists that are laden
with synthetic fragrances, alcohols, and preservatives, this hydrosol is the very soul of the cherry
blossom, distilled. It is the aromatic water that remains after the steam distillation of the
delicate petals and leaves. This gentle process yields a product that is both potent enough to
deliver visible results and mild enough to be embraced by the most sensitive skin types.

  The global beauty and wellness industry is witnessing a quiet but profound revolution, and it is

introduction of Cherry Blossoms Hydrosol, a pristine botanical water that captures the ephemeral

to offer a multi-sensory experience of healing, hydration, and harmony. In an era where consumers
are increasingly scrutinizing ingredient lists and demanding transparency, the allure of Cherry
Blossoms Hydrosol lies in its radical purity. Unlike conventional toners or mists that are laden
with synthetic fragrances, alcohols, and preservatives, this hydrosol is the very soul of the cherry
blossom, distilled. It is the aromatic water that remains after the steam distillation of the
delicate petals and leaves. This gentle process yields a product that is both potent enough to
deliver visible results and mild enough to be embraced by the most sensitive skin types.
